total_site_area_sqm.derivation: Area of PROV-SITE-001 provisional boundary polygon (EPSG:4548 projection)

green_coverage_ratio.derivation: Design target: (green space + water area) / total site area >= 40%

sponge_capture_rate_ratio.derivation: Design target: annual runoff capture rate per Sponge City guideline, corresponding to 33.6mm design rainfall

renewable_energy_share_ratio.derivation: Design target: renewable energy / total energy consumption >= 20%

green_mode_share_ratio.derivation: Design target: (slow traffic + public transit) / total trips >= 60%

public_space_500m_coverage_ratio.derivation: Design target: 100% of site within 500m walking distance of public space

total_gfa_sqm.derivation: Conceptual estimate based on land use allocation, pending official regulatory plan data

ai_scenario_nodes_count.reason: Conceptual target of 50+ nodes; exact count depends on implementation detail beyond concept design scope

talent_apartment_ratio.derivation: Concept recommendation: 15% of residential GFA as talent apartments

annual_ai_events_count.reason: Operational vision of 100+ events/year; not a government commitment, depends on future operational planning

phased_projects_count.derivation: Count of named projects in phasing.geojson and proposal chapter 9

sponge_facilities_count.derivation: 32 rain gardens + 6 detention water bodies + 12 sunken green spaces

site_area_sqm.derivation: Alias for total_site_area_sqm; provisional SITE_BOUNDARY area (EPSG:4548)

green_ratio.derivation: Computed from green_space.geojson polygon area / site_boundary area (EPSG:4548); design target >= 40%

public_space_ratio.derivation: Computed from public_space.geojson polygon area / site_boundary area (EPSG:4548); represents direct polygon coverage, not 500m service radius
